name: Melt Text
description: Lettering that thaws under the pointer: drops bead at the bottoms of the letters, lengthen and fall into a faint puddle.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. It stays real text, crisp at rest; a liquid copy beneath it carries the drops.

props.name: intensity
props.description: From 0 to 1: how quickly letters warm under the pointer and how many drops may hang at once (one to three). Each spot rests for a few seconds after it drips.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the letters and the meltwater. Defaults to the inherited text colour.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span, an inline block. Leave about half an em below it for the drops and the puddle line. Under reduced motion the text stays still.
